descriptions.text: Rev-Up Immunity Smoothie. One part moonshine, and one part fairy, this smoothie offers 10 doses for the price of one! Each sip of this delicious concoction imbues the following effects: Temporary immunity to all health-seeping conditions and debuffs. Temporary protection against all communicable diseases. Inflicts the Buzzed debuff. …

beats.headline: Two boxes in a corner
beats.text: In the corner of the clurichauns' room, Carl pulls a dangling banner, Rev-Up Smoothies! Invigorating!, off the wall and looks over two child-sized stationary bikes. A pulley runs from each tire to a little platform: a bicycle-powered blender, apparently never used. One wooden box holds twelve glass containers with screw-on lids and a lid with blades; the second holds six glasses, no blade, and a sheet of paper, the Rev-Up Immunity Smoothie Recipe. It needs two items. No wonder they discontinued this. Gross. It's all game setup, he tells Donut, and takes everything, one of the bikes included.

beats.headline: Blend until pink
beats.text: Tentacles are breaking through the walls when Carl shouts that he needs to make a goddamned smoothie. A third of a glass of moonshine; the dead laminak shoved in headfirst, her shoulders cracking; the bladed top screwed on. He sits on the much-too-small bike with his knees at his chest, recites the recipe aloud, and pedals. The fairy spins away, green, then red, then pink, and it starts to sparkle. Running, with the Taint already on him, he takes a sip that tastes like a diseased skunk, and shoves it at Donut to drink too.

beats.headline: Infection negated
beats.text: The smoothie does not lift the Taint Carl already carries, so he still cannot heal, but a pair of icons flashes for his immunity, and both of them are Buzzed: he laughs at his own death measles joke, and Donut slurs as she fires her missiles. Then a new tentacle, covered in hundreds of tiny orifices, sprays a fine green mist through the chamber. You've been infected with the Vigorous Measles! Infection negated due to immunity!

beats.headline: A dud infusion
beats.text: Two smoke curtains are infusing at Carl's table, an idea from the cookbook he has been experimenting with. In the first he is trying a smoke curtain with a splash of the Rev-Up immunity smoothie he made on the second floor, the potion that gives temporary disease immunity and makes you drunk off your ass. He can tell right away it is a bust: the curtain is blacked out and has gained the Dud status, which is what usually happens. The second infusion, a recipe from the cookbook, works.
